plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Electrical Engineering BS graduation plan text PDF ('Graduation Plan - 4 years'; the PDF also contains alternate 5-year plans for MATH 1010/MATH 1050 starters, which are NOT transcribed here — only the standard 4-year plan). Semester totals as printed: 15 / 16 / 17 / 15 / 14.5 / 16 / 15 / 15 = 123.5, matching the printed 'Total Hours 123.5'. Lecture+lab pairs printed on combined rows (e.g., 'ECE 2700 & ECE 2705' = 4 credits) are modeled as single combined entries per the source's own hour groupings. Course titles verified against the 2025-2026 catalog: ECE 2100 Semiconductor Devices; ECE 2280 Microelectronics; ECE 2700 Digital Circuits; ECE 3300 Electromagnetics & Transmission Lines; ECE 3500 Signals and Systems; ECE 3600 Power Electronics; ECE 3730 Embedded Systems I; ECE 4000 EE Product Design I; ECE 4010 EE Product Design II; MECH 1000 Introduction to Design & Rapid Prototyping; MECH 1200 Coding; MECH 2210 Circuits; MECH 2250 Sensors & Actuators; MECH 3200 Systems & Controls; CHEM 1210 Principles of Chemistry I (PS); PHYS 2210 Physics/Scientists Engineers I (PS); PHYS 2220 Physics/Scientists Engineers II; MATH 1210 Calculus I (MA); MATH 1220 Calculus II (MA); MATH 2210 Multivariable Calculus (MA); MATH 2250 Differential Equations and Linear Algebra; MATH 3400 Probability & Statistics; ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN); ENGL 3010 Professional Writing and Business Ethics. 'Tech Elective (N)' slots are choice placeholders (numbered 1-6); see the 2025-2026 catalog for the approved Technical Elective list. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
